Production handoff notes

PBR channels

Use Base Color, Normal, Roughness, Height, Ambient Occlusion, and Metalness for metallic response in PBR engines.

Real-world scale

Treat one tile as a metal sheet, plate, or panel repeat; tune UV scale so brushing, perforation, rust, or tread detail matches asset size.

Software handoff

Use metallic-roughness in Blender and glTF. Pack AO/Roughness/Metalness into ORM manually when an Unreal project expects packed masks.

Current limits

Exports include packed Unreal ORM and Unity mask ZIPs, but not native .uasset, Unity .mat, or .blend node groups; check color space and channel packing after import.

Frequently asked questions

Are these textures free to use?

Yes. Every texture is generated in your browser and free to export for commercial and personal projects.

Are the textures seamless and tileable?

Yes. The procedural patterns tile seamlessly so they repeat without visible seams on large surfaces.

Which PBR maps can I export?

You can export base color, normal, roughness, height, ambient occlusion, and metalness maps for your engine of choice.
